answer: Before first payout, the holder speaks a one-time code beneath a willow at an echo canyon, the juniper slopes throwing it back, and records it. Two verifiers match the echo against the survey within a day; a recording claimed twice, or an echo matching no canyon, closes both. A guided visit costs 2.5 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand and 2.5 billion. The willow marks the spot where the echo answers.
